run_summary: The research desk identified a critical weather alert regarding Typhoon No. 24 affecting Miyazaki Prefecture and several ongoing volcanic activity warnings. Other updates include minor operational news from JR Central and Haneda Airport, which are of lower immediate impact for the average traveler.

candidates.title: Travel Alert: Typhoon No. 24 Impacting Miyazaki Prefecture
candidates.what_changed: The Japan Meteorological Agency has issued warnings for Typhoon No. 24, with heavy rain and potential landslides expected in southern and northern plains and mountainous areas of Miyazaki.
candidates.why_it_matters: Travelers in or planning to visit Miyazaki should expect potential transport disruptions and safety risks due to severe weather conditions starting from the evening of September 5, 2026.
candidates.traveler_action: Monitor local weather reports, check transport operator websites for delays or cancellations, and follow instructions from local authorities.
candidates.related_guide_opportunity: How to handle weather disruptions in Japan
candidates.reason: High traveler value and immediate safety impact.

candidates.title: Volcanic Activity Warnings: Suwanose-jima, Kirishima, and Others
candidates.location: Various (Suwanose-jima, Kirishima, E-Akan, Aso, Sakurajima, Kuchinoerabu-jima)
candidates.what_changed: The JMA maintains volcanic activity warnings (Level 2 or 3) for several volcanoes, with ashfall forecasts issued for September 5, 2026.
candidates.why_it_matters: Travelers visiting these specific regions may face local access restrictions or minor travel inconveniences due to volcanic ash.
candidates.traveler_action: Check specific volcano status before visiting mountainous areas in Kyushu or Hokkaido; avoid restricted zones.
candidates.reason: Important safety information for hikers and regional travelers.

candidates.title: Temporary Closure: Haneda Airport Terminal 3 Observation Deck
candidates.what_changed: The Terminal 3 Observation Deck is temporarily closed.
candidates.why_it_matters: Travelers expecting to use the observation deck for photography or leisure will be unable to access it.
candidates.traveler_action: Check the Haneda Airport website for updates on reopening before planning a visit to the deck.
candidates.reason: Low impact; only relevant to those specifically planning to visit the deck.
